note: product-audit should fire when someone wants to step back and assess a whole product they have already built: which features deserve to stay, whether it has grown too complicated, whether its direction still holds. It must stay silent for a decision about one feature, a visual design critique, a diff or bug, building or fixing something, repository cleanup, and research on an idea with no code.

Do a product audit of this repo. I want to know which features are earning their keep and which are dead weight.
